topics.title: Greninja's Ninja Origins: History, Folklore, and Japanese Art
topics.shortDescription: When most people think of Ninjas, they imagine warriors dressed head to toe in black, vanishing in clouds of smoke while hurling shuriken through the air. Greninja certainly seems to fit that image, but like the real history of ninjas, there's much more beneath the surface.
